This proposal aims to solve the following problem: As a core production-grade tool for Cardano smart contracts, Plutarch requires consistent upkeep and enhancements to align with network growth and upcoming hardforks.
This proposal addresses the need for dedicated funding to maintain Plutarch's resilience, add features, and ensure ongoing compatibility, supporting developers and strengthening the ecosystem.
Without dedicated funding, this essential tool risks becoming outdated, hindering developer productivity.
Project Solution This proposal ensures Plutarch remains robust, up-to-date, and supported, benefiting Cardano developers and dApp projects who rely on it.
